Name: Joja's Extended Cellar
Author: tikamin557
Description:
(Please note that the screenshots in the "IMAGES" section include those taken with the color reduction mod.)

I made this mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11806]Joja's Recolor Farm House[/url], but it can also be used by itself.

The settings can be fine-tuned by changing the settings in ModConfig.
You can use this mod even if you don't like the Joja style, because you can make its appearance completely similar to Vanilla's.
If you set each item in ModConfig to “Vanilla”, the color of the recolor mod will be displayed if you are using another recolor mod. This means that it is compatible in most cases with other recolor mods.

Currently, English(default) and Japanese translation files are included.
